articles.title: Google Fixes 10 Chrome Vulnerabilities, Including Memory Corruption Flaw Found With Claude AI
articles.summary:
Google released a Chrome Stable security update fixing 10 vulnerabilities across Windows, Mac, and Linux, including a high-severity DOM memory corruption flaw reported by Xinyang Ge of Anthropic with Claude AI. The update also addresses one critical, six high-severity, and three medium-severity vulnerabilities. Google announced the update on October 15, 2026. Google is rolling out […]

articles.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Collabora Online Flaw to Backdoor Nextcloud Servers
articles.summary:
Hackers are exploiting a critical flaw in the Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server app for Nextcloud, with users reporting web shells on compromised servers. Tracked as CVE-2026-110447, the vulnerability allows remote attackers to run operating system commands without logging in.
